data.title: OS Therapies: Regulatory Momentum for Herlystic Supports Continued Buy Rating with Unchanged $6 Price Target
data.description:
Analyst Jason McCarthy of Maxim Group maintained a Buy rating on OS Therapies Incorporated, retaining the price target of $6.00.

Jason McCarthy has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, primarily centered on the advancing regulatory profile of Herlystic, OS Therapies’ lead osteosarcoma immunotherapy. He views the recent alignment among MHRA, EMA, and FDA on trial design, historical controls, and the use of accelerated pathways as materially reducing regulatory uncertainty and enhancing the probability of approval.

With the $6 price target unchanged, he believes the current valuation does not fully reflect these regulatory milestones and the potential economic upside from designations such as the Rare Pediatric Disease PRV, supporting his continued Buy recommendation on OSTX.

data.title: Nuvectis Oncology Reaffirmed at Buy as Analyst Cites Differentiated BRAF Pipeline and Maintains $30 Price Target
data.description:
In a report released yesterday, Naz Rahman from Maxim Group reiterated a Buy rating on Nuvectis Pharma, with a price target of $30.00.

Naz Rahman has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, primarily centered on the differentiated oncology pipeline Nuvectis is advancing. He highlights NXP200 as a next‑generation, brain‑penetrant BRAF inhibitor designed to overcome resistance and safety limitations seen with first‑generation BRAF therapies, addressing a clear unmet medical need in difficult‑to‑treat gliomas and other BRAF‑mutated tumors.
